map.PPM 和 DPMO 的区别？: What is the difference between PPM and DPMO?
map.PPM 是不合格品占检验总数的百万分率，DPMO 是缺陷数占\"单位数×机会数\: PPM is the nonconforming units as parts per million of total inspected; DPMO is defects as parts per million of "units × opportunities". Scenarios with multiple defect opportunities use DPMO for better accuracy.
